item.title: Powerful storm hits an East Coast still buried under last week's snow
item.description: Blizzardlike conditions stemming from a "bomb cyclone" brought heavy snow to the Southeast and ushered in frigid temperatures to much of the East Coast.

item.title: Partial government shutdown continues with House due to return Monday
item.description: The Senate passed a deal on a package of spending bills late Friday, sending it to the House, though funding for dozens of government agencies lapsed until the House takes it up.

item.title: Bad Bunny says "ICE out" at Grammy Awards: "We're not aliens"
item.description: Bad Bunny used his Grammy acceptance speech on Sunday to denounce U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and call for the end of the ongoing immigration crackdown.

item.title: Kennedy Center to close for construction for 2 years, Trump says
item.description: Complete closure of the performing arts center in Washington, D.C., will start on July 4, Mr. Trump said in a social media post.

item.title: 2/1: Face The Nation
item.description: This week on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," we speak to mayors from cities across the country as anger at ICE persists across the country, plus our interview with Venezuelan opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner María Corina Machado.

item.title: Who won Grammy Awards for 2026? See the full winners list here
item.description: The 2026 Grammy Awards recognized the best of the best in music from last year. Here's the full list of winners and nominees.

item.title: The Grammy Awards were Sunday. Here's how to watch and what to know.

item.title: 2/1/2026: Minneapolis; The Far Side of the Moon; Boom Chicago
item.description: First, calls grow for an independent probe into Minneapolis shootings. Then, NASA's journey to the far side of the moon. And, the Amsterdam improv club behind comedy legends.

item.title: 2/1: Sunday Morning
item.description: Hosted by Jane Pauley. Featured: Olympic figure skater Ilia Malinin; author and podcaster Mel Robbins; Jeff Tweedy of Wilco; folk singer Jesse Welles; TV theme songs; and an Arkansas family on black bear hunting.

item.title: Massive release of Epstein files includes 3 million documents and photos
item.description: The Justice Department released more new documents Friday from the Jeffrey Epstein files, more than a month after the DOJ's original deadline to do so.
